text.title: Two-Pass: Free-Form Reasoning Then Structured Extraction Failure Modes
text.summary: 6 antipatterns observed in real deployments. Each pairs symptom + root cause + concrete fix. Two were added in 1.2.0 with the format-tax correction: keeping the format instruction after removing the constraint, and blaming the format tax for missing required fields.

antipattern.symptom: Author adds a 'reasoning' field to the strict schema and claims it equals two-pass. Adding a long reasoning field to a strict schema as a substitute for two-pass on math or research tasks.
antipattern.root-cause: Embedded scratchpad works for medium tasks, but the schema is still stated in the same prompt — and the format INSTRUCTION carries 92% of the measured degradation, before any decoder constraint. A reasoning field inside the schema does not remove the instruction; it is the instruction.
antipattern.fix: Switch to two-pass when difficulty saturates the scratchpad — A/B is the test. The embedded scratchpad pattern works for medium-difficulty reasoning, but the schema is still stated up front, so the format instruction is still compressing the reasoning channel on the hard tasks — the scratchpad field does not undo that. The hidden-scratchpad variant (extended thinking, then format) recovers +9.2 pp on average but worsens 15 percent of combinations; two-pass is the lower-variance choice. When task difficulty saturates the scratchpad, switch to two-pass.

antipattern.symptom: Pass 2 uses Opus or another strong model with strict SO 'for safety', erasing the cost win.
antipattern.root-cause: Extraction does not need strong-model reasoning; defaulting to Opus is over-engineering.
antipattern.fix: Use Haiku (or equivalent) for pass 2. Strong-model extraction is only justified when Haiku fails a structured-output eval > 5%.

antipattern.symptom: Two-pass adopted on faith. Subsequent eval shows single-pass was within 2%, doubling cost for nothing.
antipattern.root-cause: Cargo-cult on the pattern without measuring task difficulty.
antipattern.fix: Run A/B on 50+ tasks before adopting; require ≥5% absolute delta to justify the double-call cost.

antipattern.symptom: Pass 1 drops `tool_choice` / `response_format` but its prompt still shows the schema or says "reply as JSON"; the A/B shows almost no gain and the pattern is written off as cargo cult.
antipattern.root-cause: The decoder constraint was never the main cost. 92% of significant degradations are present with the format-requesting instruction alone, so removing only the constraint removes almost none of the tax.
antipattern.fix: Strip the format request from the pass-1 prompt entirely — no schema, no field list, no "as JSON". The consumer's contract belongs to pass 2 and to nothing else.

antipattern.symptom: A provider SDK returns objects missing REQUIRED fields at a high rate; the team cites the format tax and moves to plain-text parsing without investigating.

root-cause.source: Anthropic structured-outputs docs, fetched 2026-08-03; internal Sonnet 4.5 Agent SDK observation

antipattern.root-cause: Under real constrained decoding a required field cannot be omitted — the grammar makes the closing brace unreachable until it is emitted. A high omission rate is therefore evidence that grammar constraints were not applied on that path (schema passed as a prompt instruction, a soft JSON mode, or an errored fallback). The format tax explains accuracy loss, not omission.
antipattern.fix: Move to prose-then-parse if you want — it is the researched-correct shape either way — but log the request as sent and confirm which path ran. Do not generalise one SDK's behaviour to the provider's API.

antipattern.symptom: Sending the original question plus the full reasoning trace to the extractor.
antipattern.root-cause: Doubles the extractor's input bill without improving extraction quality — the trace already contains everything the extractor needs. Send only the trace (or the trace plus a one-line task hint).
antipattern.fix: Pass-2 input is the transcript only, optionally with a one-line task hint; keep the extractor system prompt stable so it hits the cache prefix.
